content: {"reasoning":"Required authorization is missing, retroactive authorization and peer-to-peer review are unavailable, and a medical-necessity appeal has already been attempted. Repeating the appeal or submitting the unchanged claim has no demonstrated benefit in similar claims. CO-197 assigns contractual responsibility to the provider, and no valid transfer of liability to the patient is documented; deductible and coinsurance alone do not make this denied balance collectible from the patient.","action":"write_off"}
